items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What was the -- I was talking with Sonny Greer. He grew up in Long Branch, New Jersey. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yes.

ctx.x: And I was so interested in the bass fiddle. So that it wound up that my folks sent me up to Boston to try to make a career in music, especially playing the bass fiddle.
What was the -- I was talking with Sonny Greer. He grew up in Long Branch, New Jersey.
